methods: Exact source hash verification and immutable input copies
Exact functions loaded without __main__; process/I/O/sleep mocked for pure probes
positive_checks: Scope binds four exact driver files and installed bundle inventory
Release binds scope SHA, controller exit SHA, outer/controller PIDs and random nonce
Root identity list must match wrapper-derived identities; unknown identity error blocks release
Two observations with stable release SHA required; no product terminate/retry operations

findings.issue: Scanner filters by bundled executable names before checking known PIDs. A known PID reused for another executable name is absent from rows, allowing two clean scans despite the stated any-known-PID blocker contract.
findings.required: Include known PIDs regardless of executable name in read-only scan; unknown/reused identity must remain a blocker.

findings.issue: After controller spawn, exit/spawn/waiting receipt writes and print are outside a fail-preserving guard. An I/O or broken-output exception can terminate the wrapper before reconciliation, contradicting its main purpose.
findings.required: Establish a post-spawn catch/hold boundary that cannot exit on diagnostic I/O failure; retain original controller result and require reconciled release even when reporting fails.

limitations: No actual process inventory, native GUI, Win32 pipe or external host/job lifetime exercised. Existing v2 lifecycle/helpers are byte-identical and inherited from prior source review only.
